name: 每日研究博客：推进巡检与 Codex 内容恢复
description: 北京时间08:15至22:15每小时巡检；等待在途任务、补启动漏跑任务、用Codex修复保存的稿件并重新复核，最终验证双语文章和首页列表。每天最多两次内容恢复，权限或基础设施问题保留失败报告，不修改服务器。

workflow.policy: Scope is daily blog content only. Reuse cached evidence; fresh factual and bilingual final review are mandatory. Count all writer/watchdog calls, including failures. Do not reset denials, restart services, change code/config/credentials, fetch sources through Codex, or alter other tasks. Missing upstream can be enqueued once under its existing collection policy.
